name: AWS WAF - Security Analytics - Traffic
description: Analyze AWS WAF traffic to improve situational awareness around firewall-related threat intelligence. Breakouts according to country and rule type generate clear actionable insights, enabling security engineering teams to act on unexpected anomalies in allowed traffic and blocked traffic patterns.
title: AWS WAF - Security Analytics - Traffic
